Forest Officer Suspended for Feeding Sambar Deer in Narmadapuram

A forest officer in Narmadapuram, Madhya Pradesh, has been suspended after a video showing him feeding poha to a sambar deer went viral. The incident occurred in the Satpura Tiger Reserve, where the officer, identified as SDO Vinod Verma, was filmed making a reel with the deer to the song 'Tum Bin Jaaun Kahan'. The suspension was issued by the forest department following the circulation of the video.
